products.tagline: Forecast your SaaS future with Forecastr's monthly financial model.
products.description:
# SaaS Profit Blueprint: Financial Model Template for SaaS Founders

## What Problem Does This Solve?
Most SaaS founders waste weeks building financial models from scratch—only to end up with spreadsheets that break when assumptions change.

## Who Is This For?
Early-stage and growth-stage SaaS founders, CFOs, and operators who need investor-ready financials without hiring a finance team.

## What Do You Get?
- Pre-built Google Sheets and Excel financial model template
- Automated pricing scenario analysis (toggle between plans instantly)
- Unit economics dashboard: LTV, CAC, payback period, churn impact
- MRR/ARR growth projections with cohort logic built in
- Fundraising-ready outputs formatted for investor review

## What Happens After You Use It?
You walk into investor meetings with clear, defensible numbers. You spot unprofitable pricing tiers before they hurt growth. You make faster hiring and spending decisions because the model updates automatically.

## Why Not Build It Yourself?
Building a reliable SaaS financial model typically takes 40+ hours and requires deep spreadsheet and finance expertise. Most self-built models don't account for churn curves, expansion revenue, or multi-tier pricing complexity. This template handles all of it on day one.

**Accurate SaaS financials shouldn't require a finance degree.**

Your vault maintains itself. Backups run on schedule, imports take seconds, and organization happens without manual effort.

# Bookmark Chaos Tamer

**What problem does this solve?**
Saving bookmarks is easy. Finding them later is not. Most systems require you to manually tag, categorize, and organize every link — which nobody actually does consistently.

**Who is this for?**
Knowledge workers, researchers, and Obsidian users who collect links but lose them in the noise.

**What do you get?**
A complete bookmark management system for Obsidian with pre-built automatic tagging rules, ready-made categories, and a structured review workflow. Drop a link in, and the system handles the sorting.

**What happens after you use it?**
Your saved links become findable. You stop re-Googling things you already read. Your reading list actually gets processed instead of abandoned.

**Why not build it yourself?**
You can. It takes 6–10 hours to design a tagging taxonomy, test category logic, and build a review workflow that doesn't collapse after two weeks. This is already built, tested, and ready to use in under 30 minutes.

---

Bookmark Chaos Tamer is not a plugin. It is a vault system — templates, folders, and workflows — that works with what Obsidian already does, without extra dependencies.

# Agent Deploy Rehearsal Kit

**What problem does this solve?**
Most teams deploy AI field agents directly into live environments with no structured pre-flight check. Errors surface too late, in front of real users.

**Who is this for?**
Operations leads and AI implementers who manage field agents across multiple bases and need a repeatable testing process before going live.

**What do you get?**
A ready-to-use Excel and Google Sheets template that maps agent logic, edge cases, trigger conditions, and expected outputs in one structured workspace. Includes a scenario library and a pass/fail tracking layer.

**What happens after you use it?**
You deploy with documented evidence that your agent has been tested against real-world conditions. Fewer rollbacks. Faster sign-off from stakeholders. A reusable framework for every future deployment.

**Why not build this yourself?**
You could. But building a reliable testing structure from scratch takes time you rarely have before a deployment deadline. This gives you a proven starting point, not a blank spreadsheet.

---

The kit does one thing: it gives AI deployment a standardized rehearsal stage that currently doesn't exist in most workflows.

No code required. Works with any agent platform.
